## Gemini 3 Flash Preview API

Gemini 3 Flash Preview is a large language model by Google, available on the Venice API as `gemini-3-flash-preview`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

Gemini 3 Flash Preview is a high speed, high value thinking model designed for agentic workflows, multi-turn chat, and coding assistance. It delivers near Pro level reasoning with substantially lower latency.

### Gemini 3 Flash Preview API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gemini-3-flash-preview` | Standard | Anonymized | $0.70 / $3.75 per 1M |

### Gemini 3 Flash Preview specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Google |
| Released | Dec 19, 2025 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Context window | 256K tokens |
| Max output | 64K tokens |
| Reasoning effort | none, low, medium, high |

### How to use the Gemini 3 Flash Preview API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "gemini-3-flash-preview"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gemini-3-flash-preview",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }],
    "reasoning_effort": "high"
  }'
```
